caption: The drawing depicts an ornamental architectural element that appears to be a decorative drain head or rainwater collector, rendered in shades of gray, brown, and blue. The object is composed of a central, rectangular section that projects outward and features a relief carving of a sailing ship with multiple masts and sails unfurled. Above the ship, the letters "DPK" are inscribed, while below the ship, the year "1802" is prominently carved. On either side of the central section, there are protruding rectangular projections, each adorned with a relief depicting a cluster of leaves. The upper edge of the object has a horizontal, cornice-like molding, while the lower portion tapers into a rounded spout. The entire object is centrally placed on a plain light-colored background, and the shading suggests a three-dimensional quality.
title: Ornamental Downspout
